name: Maria Morrello
bioAdditions: Maria Marrello (the tree's 'Morrello') was buried at San Mango on 20 March 1846, aged 60. She is named as the daughter of the late Vincenzo Marrello and of Giacinta Gabriele Fiorillo, and as the wife of Domenico Gabriele Fiorillo (S1). Her son Carmine's 1840 marriage names her, still living, as his mother (S2). Her daughters Cintia and Antonia were born at Aiello Calabro (S3). Her father Vincenzo matches the tree. Her mother is given as Giacinta Gabriele Fiorillo, not the tree's Ippolita Guercio Nuzio. She is therefore a direct ancestor (Carmine's mother), replacing 'Vittoria Marrelli'.

conflicts.assessment: Single derivative source (burial index); death-record parent names can be wrong. Treat the Guercio/Morrello-Magaro pedigree as unverified until Aiello Calabro records are checked.
Burial the day after death; consistent.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: She is Carmine's mother per the 1840 marriage; her burial gives age and father.
